dossier.public_summary: This 13.5-day 1000 ppm dip changes depth by almost a factor of three between sectors and even within the same pipeline, and individual transits range from ~3500 ppm to nearly zero. No difference image pinpoints the source on the target, while a star just 10.5 arcsec away could produce the signal. Together this favors a nearby variable or blended eclipsing binary rather than a 2.6 Earth-radius planet.

reasons.why: Depth varies strongly between sectors, far beyond errors, incompatible with a planet on target which should have steady depth.
